podcast.title: 21st Century Tweetpop Descendant
podcast.body: Arlo Parks is presented as a 21st-century artist working within the Bedroom Pop genre, which is described as a direct descendant of Tweetpop. Her music, like others in the genre, is often dreamy, introspective, sensitive, and vulnerable, a style made possible by accessible modern recording technology. "We wouldn't have artists like Girl in Red or Beba Dooby or Arlo Parks, Rex Orange County, and Sockermummy if it wasn't for the various flavors of Tweet Pop."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: 21st Century Tweetpop Descendant
xref.body: Rex Orange County is identified as a 21st-century artist in the Bedroom Pop genre, a style that owes its existence and characteristics (dreamy, introspective, sensitive, vulnerable) to various forms of Tweetpop. This musical approach is enabled by the affordability and power of modern recording equipment, such as laptops and software. "We wouldn't have artists like Girl in Red or Beba Dooby or Arlo Parks, Rex Orange County, and Sockermummy if it wasn't for the various flavors of Tweet Pop."

xref.title: 21st Century Tweetpop Descendant
xref.body: Sockermummy is listed as a 21st-century artist whose "Bedroom Pop" output is a direct descendant of Tweetpop. This genre thrives thanks to cheap and powerful laptops, recording software, and microphones, allowing for intimate, personal, dreamy, introspective, sensitive, and vulnerable music that echoes the Tweetpop sensibility. "We wouldn't have artists like Girl in Red or Beba Dooby or Arlo Parks, Rex Orange County, and Sockermummy if it wasn't for the various flavors of Tweet Pop."
